clips.transcript: Power fault. Life support degraded. Communications offline. Check engineering diagnostics.
Aurora Seven, we received your position. We're assessing recovery options. Conserve power and life support. Rescue is not yet confirmed.
Mission Control, this is Houston aboard Aurora Seven. We're drifting off course. Do you copy? Please respond.

note: All three performances accepted by Alex as audio previews; Houston05 accepted Nov14 after correction to astronaut calling Earth. PCM validation is separate from an automated transcription audit. No NASA recording or Retellai voice is used.
